festivals.what: Feria Nacional de San Marcos, Aguascalientes: the 198th edition (2026) ran 18 April to 10 May, with the state government presenting the official programme. 2027 dates not yet published; it has run from mid-April into early May in recent years.

sources.title: Tere Jiménez presenta el programa oficial de la Feria Nacional de San Marcos 2026

laws.rule: Aguascalientes bans selling and drinking alcohol on public roads, in parks and in public squares, unless an authorised venue operates there; events may be authorised by the council (Ley que regula la Venta y Consumo de Bebidas Alcohólicas, art. 19). Venues must stop selling and serving on election days set by federal and state electoral law, and on days a council orders for safety (art. 22). Venues may not serve under-18s even when with an adult (art. 10). The text on OJN is the 2001 publication; later reforms were not checked.

local-law.notes: Added 8 November 2026 from the federal Orden Jurídico Nacional (OJN) compilation of the state's laws. OJN versions can lag the state gazette, so entries name the last reform shown on the text where it was visible. Amounts in MXN; A$1 = about MXN 13.23 (RBA 30 October 2026, A$1 = USD 0.7040, crossed with the Banco de México FIX for 30 October 2026, USD 1 = MXN 18.7962); UMA 2026 = MXN 117.31.
